paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved +1.54% on average, with Nasdaq strongest (+2.31%) and FTSE 100 weakest (+0.84%). Brent crude changed +0.88% to 95.44. Gold changed +2.94% to 3,639.6001. Bitcoin changed -1.23% to 59,129.3984. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.936%, a relative move of +1.82%. Among the firms tracked, Gold Miners (ETF) (+7.16%) and Newmont (+5.35%) moved the most.
